page.overview:
Who is Hecaton Aiakos?

Hecaton Aiakos, also known as the "Guardian of the Daedelos Krata," the flagship of the Minotaurs' Chapter fleet, and the "Terror of Bifrost," is a Contemptor Pattern Dreadnought of the Minotaurs Space Marine Chapter.

As with much that surrounds this fearsome Chapter of Space Marines, the history and perhaps even the true name of the being entombed within this ornate Contemptor Pattern Dreadnought is shrouded in mystery.

Hecaton Aiakos served at the forefront of a dozen of the Minotaurs Chapter's major campaigns over the last several standard centuries.

He was identified by the distinctive heraldry designating his participation in the Battle of Optera during the boarding assault on the Lamenters Chapter strike cruiser Mater Suspiria during the Badab War, the defence of the Black Gates of Hive Vitria against the Genestealer Cult of the Dreaming Deeps and, perhaps infamously, he was at the forefront of the slaughter of the "Traitor 2-19th" during the Bifrost Uprising.
